image_description: A white plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against a beige vinyl-sided house wall. The barrel sits on a dark green elevated stand. A flexible black downspout diverter connects to the side of the barrel near the top. A metal spigot is visible near the base. There is a manufacturer label 'DIVERSI' (or similar) on the upper section.

AI often smears this into a seamless but physically impossible merge.
